title: promotions.codes.issue
description: Mint new unique codes of an existing promotion, e.g. a referral reward. Output: {promotion_key, codes: [string]}. Unknown promotion_key fails the call. idempotency_key (optional, namespaced by the caller, e.g. 'referrals:reward:<id>'): a retry with the same key answers the codes the first call minted and mints nothing; the same key with a different request fails the call. Without it every call mints.
